verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe recurring scheduled routines ("every weekday at 8:00 AM"), event-triggered routines from Slack or GitHub, and saved skills that rerun on a schedule. These run on a persistent cloud computer that keeps working while the laptop is closed. A month-long community user corroborates that async work "actually works" with bots owning their own routines. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that scheduled or event-triggered routines specifically fire reliably unattended, and detailed docs on how Auto Review and approval prompts affect fully unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
